$comment: V0.7 Pass 063: the production standards shared by the Blender helpers (tools/art/v07/cozy_art.py), the GLB validator (validation/AssetStandards.ts) and docs/V07_ART_PRODUCTION.md. Values are the approved Pass 062 Crafted Stylized Realism (B) benchmark's, measured from its sources.

space.units: metres in game units (the tank's scale: real animals x ~5.75)
space.up: +Y in glTF / game (Blender +Z, exported with export_yup)

origin.fish: body centre on the lateral line, between snout and tail root
origin.creature: body centre (swimmers) or ventral contact point (crawlers)
origin.reef: on the sand plane at the footprint centre; the buried skirt extends below 0
origin.plant: at the holdfast on the sand plane
origin.prop: on the floor/sand plane at the footprint centre

fish-skin.note: Calm scale relief: softened normals at 60 %, colour fields evened; species colour lives in the base map.

fur.note: Wet or dry pelt (polar bear, sea otter): combed relief in the normal map, matte, species colour in the base map.

feather.note: Sleek plumage (penguins, gull): fine barb relief, satin sheen; markings in the base map.

fin.note: Translucent membrane: ray detail and edge alpha in the base map; depth write off; review overlaps in schools.

shell.note: Calcium carbonate: growth ridges in geometry, fine growth lines in normals, gloss only on worn crests.

coral-tissue.note: Living tissue over skeleton: corallite cups and septa in maps, colour gradient (dark base to pale growing tips) in vertex colour.

limestone.note: World-space triplanar at runtime (rockTexelScale 0.85); broad bedding and a few crisp pockets; AO from cavity in vertex colour.

sand.note: Shared tank sand (Pass 014): grain and micro-ripple maps; large ripples stay in geometry.

plant.note: Blades and fronds: clean veins/midrib in maps, deep-to-light gradient in vertex colour, phase in UV1 for sway.

metal.note: Submerged metal: metalness only where bare metal shows on worn edges (ORM blue); crust and rust are dielectric and rough.

wood.note: Waterlogged timber: softened grain, rounded worn edges, silt in recesses.

LOD1.note: silhouette kept; morphs transferred; small appendages may drop

LOD2.note: static scenery only; fish/creatures use LOD1 and impostors are not used
